data.name: Jedidiah
data.gender_notes: Jedidiah is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jedidiah comes from the Hebrew words Jedid (beloved) and Yah (God). It means 'beloved of the Lord'. The name Jedidiah carries the meaning “Beloved of the Lord” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Jedidiah usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved of the lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing God's love and devotion towards the bearer.
data.etymology: Jedidiah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved of the Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jedidiah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jedidiah, holding the meaning 'beloved of the Lord', has been cherished throughout history and various cultures as a mark of deep respect, acknowledgement, and appreciation for the divine love and protection bestowed upon an individual. In the history of Western culture, this name could be seen as an inspiration to many believers in maintaining a pious and devoted lifestyle as a sign of the special relationship between an individual and God.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jedidiah carries a significant spiritual weight as it is a constant reminder of the unwavering love and acceptance of God towards his children (beloved ones). The name instills a deep sense of awe and reverence, inspiring the individual to strive towards a pattern of living that embodies the love and compassion they have received. This spiritual significance transcends culture and time, making Jedidiah a cherished name among faithful believers in every age and place.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jedidiah means "beloved of the Lord," evoking the idea of God's love and favor towards His chosen ones. It is a reminder of God's covenant promises and the deep bond between the child and their divine Savior.

modern_usage.modern_context: Jedidiah is a beautiful and unique name with roots in the Bible. It means 'beloved of the Lord' and is most famously associated with King Jedidiah, also known as Solomon's son. While not as commonly used as some other Biblical names, Jedidiah is gaining popularity among parents who seek unique and meaningful names for their children. It has been seen on social media as a trendy name choice, in baby names lists as a unique option, and in literature as a character name.
